prompt: Explain why the sky is blue in one sentence.
outputText: The sky appears blue because Rayleigh scattering causes shorter-wavelength light (blue and violet) to scatter more strongly than longer wavelengths, making them dominate our view of the sky.

modes.label: Weights
modes.description: 188/345 loaded tensors observed. Blocks never cross tensor boundaries; final blocks may be shorter. 144 tensors have no recorded shape and are excluded from the atlas. Known-size missing tensors retain their full block extent.

modes.label: Weight × input
modes.quantity: RMS connection product per output-row group
modes.description: layer_0/ffnDown: precomputed sum of squared weights × input², grouped over up to 128 output rows. No per-token weight matrix is materialized.

modes.label: Attention · current query
modes.description: 6 captured layer(s), ordered layer → query → head → key. Prompt chunks share global position coordinates. CPU double reconstruction from captured Q and stored K, with recorded scale, mask and softcap; future masked positions are zero. Not kernel bit-exact or causal attribution.

modes.label: Attention · prompt relationships

modes.label: Memory retention & update gates
modes.quantity: retention factor, update strength per head
modes.description: Recomputed from captured projections and parameters; alternating retention exp(log-decay) and update sigmoid values. Not a claim of kernel bit-exact arithmetic.

modes.label: Next-token scores
modes.description: Vocabulary token-ID order. These are scores before sampling filters; a missing position has no captured prediction.

modes.description: Vocabulary token-ID order. These are scores before sampling filters; a missing position has no captured prediction.

modes.label: Weight quantization error
modes.quantity: stored head minus tied embedding reference
modes.description: lm_head (q4k) minus embed (f16) from the same pinned artifact, whose contract ties these weights. Exact saved window only; reference precision is not original F32 precision.

modes.label: Weight residency & access
modes.quantity: resident tensor and observed projection binding
modes.description: One scalar per tensor: 1 = down-projection dispatch encoded for this position, 0.25 = resident at capture start, 0 = not resident. Other operator accesses, uploads and hardware cache hits are unobserved. This is not numerical importance.
